settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDesc: Choose the language for the app's interface.
settings.picnicDesc: Link your Picnic account to match recipe ingredients to real products from the Dutch online grocer.
settings.picnicCredsHint: Your credentials are used once to obtain an access key, which is stored encrypted. We never store your password.
settings.picnicSmsSent: Picnic sent a verification code by SMS. Enter it below to finish connecting.
settings.activeGrocerDesc: Choose which store search, ingredient links and ordering use. Links are kept per store.
settings.ahDesc: Searching AH works without logging in. To order, connect your account: log in at AH and paste back the code.
settings.ahAutoNote: Click below, sign in at Albert Heijn, and your account is linked automatically.
settings.ahSetupHint: One-time: run scripts/setup-ah-handler.sh so the login code is captured automatically.
settings.ahManualToggle: Automatic linking not working? Paste the code manually
settings.ahLoginInstructions: 1. Open the AH login, sign in. 2. You'll be redirected to a page that won't open (appie://login-exit?code=…). 3. Copy that URL (or just the code) and paste it below.
settings.ahCodeMissing: Couldn't find a code — paste the redirect URL or the code itself.
settings.ahConnectError: Couldn't connect to Albert Heijn. The code may have expired — try again.
settings.paprikaDesc: Connect your Paprika account to import your recipes into this app.
settings.paprikaHint: Used to sync your recipes. The password is stored encrypted.
settings.weekPlansDesc: When you order an ad-hoc recipe selection, it can be saved as a week plan automatically (no prompt).
settings.autoSaveWeekPlan: Automatically save ordered recipes as a week plan
settings.passwordDescChange: Change the password you use to sign in with your email.
settings.passwordDescSet: Set a password so you can sign in with your email address.
settings.googleSetHint: You sign in with Google. Set a password to also sign in with your email.

recipes.title: My Recipes
recipes.emptyTitle: You don't have any recipes yet.
recipes.orderTip: Tip: select recipes or grocery lists with the checkboxes to order from Picnic.

groceries.title: Weekly groceries
groceries.subtitle: Reusable lists of Picnic products. Select them on the recipes page to order alongside (or instead of) recipes.
groceries.connectHint: to search for products to add.
groceries.noListsCreate: Create one above to get started.
groceries.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" and all {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}? This can't be undone.
groceries.noProducts: No products yet — search above to add some.

ingredients.title: Link ingredients to Picnic
ingredients.subtitle: Match recipe ingredients to Picnic products. Click a word to search, or type your own term. Linking one applies it to every recipe that uses that ingredient.
ingredients.searchHint: Search Picnic — edit the term if needed
ingredients.notAvailableTitle: Can't be bought at the grocer — buy elsewhere
ingredients.unavailableIntro: These can't be bought at the grocer — buy them elsewhere. They appear on each order that uses them.
ingredients.nothingUnavailable: Nothing flagged. Use “Not available” on an ingredient that the grocer doesn’t sell.
ingredients.nothingIgnored: Nothing ignored. Use “Ignore” on a junk line to hide it here.

pantry.title: Pantry staples
pantry.subtitle: Ingredients matching these keywords are unticked by default when ordering, since you usually have them already.
pantry.keywordsDesc: Linked ingredients whose name contains one of these words are unticked by default when ordering.
pantry.overridesDesc: Force a specific linked product to be a pantry item (or never), ignoring the keywords above.
pantry.linkFirst: Link some recipe ingredients to products first.

order.title: Order overview
order.summary: {count, plural, one {# list} other {# lists}} & recipes
order.unmappedNote: · {count, plural, one {# ingredient without a product} other {# ingredients without a product}}
order.noneLinked: None of these ingredients are linked to a Picnic product yet.
order.openRecipeHint: Open a recipe to link products to ingredients.
order.added: {count, plural, one {✓ Added # product to your Picnic cart.} other {✓ Added # products to your Picnic cart.}}
order.signInToOrder: Sign in to order with Picnic
order.addToCartError: Something went wrong adding to your Picnic cart.
order.clearCartConfirm: Empty the whole order? This removes all selected recipes, lists and added products.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Orders you've added to your Picnic cart.

weekPlans.title: Week plans
weekPlans.subtitle: Saved batches of recipes you can re-order in one click. The plan you used longest ago (or never) shows on top.
weekPlans.lastDays: {days, plural, one {Last ordered # day ago} other {Last ordered # days ago}}
weekPlans.lastWeeks: {weeks, plural, one {Last ordered # week ago} other {Last ordered # weeks ago}}
weekPlans.lastMonths: {months, plural, one {Last ordered # month ago} other {Last ordered # months ago}}
weekPlans.lastYears: {years, plural, one {Last ordered # year ago} other {Last ordered # years ago}}

import.title: Import a recipe
import.subtitle: Paste a recipe URL and we'll pull in the title, ingredients, and steps. Review and edit before saving.
import.imported: Imported! Review the details below and save.
import.partial: We found the page but couldn't extract structured recipe data. We've filled in what we could — please add the ingredients and steps below.
import.noLinkScan: No link? Scan a photo or PDF
import.scanDesc: Pick a photo of a cookbook page or recipe card (or a PDF). On the next step you mark the title, ingredients, directions, and image, and we read the text with OCR.

paprikaImport.title: Import from Paprika
paprikaImport.subtitle: Load your Paprika recipes and pick which to import. Recipes you've already imported are skipped automatically.
paprikaImport.connectFirstPrefix: Connect your Paprika account first in
paprikaImport.fetchHint: This fetches all your Paprika recipes (can take 10–20 seconds).
paprikaImport.allImported: All your Paprika recipes are already imported. 🎉
paprikaImport.importedDone: {count, plural, one {✓ Imported # recipe from Paprika.} other {✓ Imported # recipes from Paprika.}}
paprikaImport.loadError: Something went wrong loading your Paprika recipes.
paprikaImport.notConnected: Connect your Paprika account in Settings first.

scan.title: Scan a recipe
scan.subtitle: Upload or snap a photo of a recipe — or upload a PDF — then draw boxes around the title, ingredients, directions, and image. We'll read the text with OCR and fill in the form for you.
scan.guestNotice: This is a read-only guest account. Sign in with your own account to scan and save recipes.
scan.readFromPhoto: Read from your photo — review the details below and save.
scan.drawHint: Drag on the image to draw a box; drag the corner handles to resize, or ✕ to remove. You can draw several Ingredients or Directions boxes — handy when they span columns. Use ↺ ↻ to rotate.
scan.imageMarked: Marked — will be cropped and saved.
scan.treatBoxesAsSteps: Treat separate direction boxes as steps
scan.saveSourceImage: Save the original photo with the recipe
scan.imageSaveFailed: Couldn't save the scan image — you can add one later.
scan.prepareFailed: Something went wrong preparing the recipe.
scan.pdfFailed: Couldn't read that PDF — try a different file or take a photo instead.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to build your personal recipe collection and import recipes from the web.
auth.registerSubtitle: Sign up to start saving and importing recipes.
auth.guestHint: Browse example recipes in a read-only demo account.
auth.name: Name

errors.fetchPageFailed: Something went wrong fetching that page.
errors.readPdfFailed: Couldn't read that PDF. Try a photo instead.
errors.readImageFailed: Could not read text from that image.
errors.imageError: Something went wrong reading that image.
errors.picnicNotLinked: Connect your Picnic account in Settings first.
errors.noProductsFound: No products found — try another word.

ingredientList.notAvailableNote: 🛒 Not available at the grocer — buy elsewhere.
ingredientList.searchHint: Search Picnic — edit the term if needed
ingredientList.orderQtyTooltip: Order quantity — scroll or use arrows
